title: Decoded Base transactions
description: This MCP server returns explanations in-band over the MCP protocol; standby runs do not write datasets. The fields below document the shape of the explanation object the explain_transaction tool returns.

summary.description: Plain-English summary of what the transaction did (1-3 sentences).

action_type.description: One of 30 deterministic classifications, e.g. swap, erc20_transfer, nft_mint, bridge_out.

assets_moved.description: Every asset that moved: token, amount (decimal string), from, to, token_address, standard.

counterparties.description: Addresses involved, labeled where known (routers, bridges, marketplaces).

risk_flags.description: Evidence-based flags: unverified_contract, unlimited_approval, approval_for_all, known_drainer, first_time_counterparty, transaction_reverted.

checks.description: Which risk checks actually ran: contract_verification, first_interaction and drainer_blacklist, each with its own status. A check that could not run reports unavailable rather than silently producing no flag, so an empty risk_flags is only meaningful read alongside this.

gas_paid_usd.description: Total gas cost in USD, including the OP-stack L1 data fee. Priced at the transaction's block when that read succeeds; under concurrency it can fall back to the latest ETH price, which gas_price_basis reports.

gas_price_basis.description: Where the ETH/USD rate behind gas_paid_usd came from. source is at-block (reproduces forever), latest (does not reproduce; used when the historical read fails, which happens under concurrency) or unavailable. Carries eth_usd, feed_block, round_id and a plain-language note.

partial.description: True when the full meaning could not be established; the summary states exactly what is and is not known.
